summary: Transportation & Logistics Systems, Inc. filed a Form 8-K to report entry into a $100,000 unsecured non-convertible promissory note with C/M Capital Master Fund, LP. The note bears 10% interest, matures in six months, and proceeds fund SEC filings, tax compliance, transfer agent costs, and routine litigation. The filing reflects routine debt financing, not a special situation. No special-situation category applies.
